issues.description: Removed two citations to rejected fact gf3-29-1 (erroneous claim about Dragon wish granting Might Armor) in the Cave North of Glasdar Tower and Cave to Glasdar Tower Dragon Egg descriptions.
Removed two uncited chunk-reference notes ([[gf1#73 not cited]], [[gf1#75 not cited]]) in Chapter 13 and one malformed chunk citation ([[gf1#75]]) in Chapter 15.
Added missing VGMaps links in Chapters 3, 4, 6, and 7 (Cave East Of Ranqs Map, Old Cave 1st-7th Level Maps, and Cave North Of Glasdar Tower Map).

Expanded sparse area sections in Chapter 2 (Cave to Sheran second pass), Chapter 5 (Kirof return), Chapter 6 (Old Cave), Chapter 7 (Red Sapphire and Old Cave), and Chapter 14 (Power Oil) with full step-by-step routing and prerequisites.

Aligned area headings in Chapter 10 (Might Helmet (Tower of Light roof)) and Chapter 15 (Elba & Ulupp Island Caves) with the roadmap labels and added the missing Chapter Checklist heading in Chapter 10.

Added source citations to uncited overview and Chapter 17 statements, removed drafting phrasing ('Packet sources do not state...'), fixed low-overlap citations across Chapters 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 11, 12, and 14, and relabeled chest-overwrite/one-time item warnings so only the true roadmap missable uses 'Missable Warning'.
